citation_problems.problem: Minor wording slip only: the sentence is introduced as 'Documented requirement also from the same source' immediately after a [[milan-finality]] citation, although the content and the explicit tag/locator that follow are the UDFS system-cancellation bullets. The attribution, locator and review date themselves are correct, so no misattribution results.
citation_problems.passage_quote: T2S automatically cancels pending instructions in the system under the following conditions: Settlement Instructions, Settlement Restrictions and Cancellation Instructions once they exceed their recycling period in T2S ... Settlement Instructions when the realignment chain cannot be built ... Instructions that do not successfully pass the revalidation process.

reason: Part (a) is conditioned exactly as the passages require: [[milan-finality]] Art. 70(1) PDF 50 'may be unilaterally cancelled by the Participant which entered them up to the time of the matching, on condition that such Settlement Instructions were not entered as non-changeable', Art. 70(2) 'Matched settlement Instructions may be cancelled bilaterally, with the consent of both Participants, or upon request of an entity acting on their behalf, subject to the prior submission to Monte Titoli of the relevant mandate', and [[t2s-cancellation]] PDF 282 'T2S requires bilateral cancellation and the cancellation is only possible if both Counterparties send their Cancellation Instructions to cancel each leg separately or if the Cancellation Instruction is sent with the information of both legs by an authorised T2S Party', with the both-legs route correctly confined to already-matched instructions per Table 60. Part (b) gives only the bundle's figures, [[t2s-recycling]] footnote 199 PDF 297 'Current recycling period for unmatched instructions of 20 working days' and footnote 200 PDF 298 'Current recycling period for matched instructions of 60 working days', quotes the start/restart rule verbatim, labels the value as operator-configured, and carries the external-CSD and Milan 'time limits provided in the Instructions' caveats. The two intents are answered separately with their own review dates (13 September for Milan, 14 September for the T2S cancellation and recycling sections), every LIMITATION line and the Italian-prevails qualification are preserved, and no time, version, amount or field beyond the passages is asserted.
